The plan

Our flagship in Old Town Yucca Valley, now in development. Opening date to be confirmed. Four residencies, a pop-up table, and an event floor for brands and creators with a point of view.

  • Window residency. About 12 by 12 ft (roughly 140 sq ft), with its own 8 ft storefront window and about 12 ft of wall.
  • Residencies 2, 3 and 4. 6 ft each on the long wall. Take one, or two side by side.
  • Pop-up table. A movable table on casters for day or week pop-ups.
  • Event floor. About 600 sq ft in the center of the room for launches, dinners, and screenings. The wall beside the front corner is the screen, and an art wall between screenings.
  • Back of house. A restroom, storage, and a rear door for load-in.
